decision: Retain current TLV7042 wired guard as engineering evaluation candidate, not qualified circuit. Defer push-pull/AND redesign until measured deficiency or a demonstrably better qualified design warrants extra area.
preconditions: Exact Q4 manufacturer part must be selected before assembly; generic2N7002 is not a procurement specification.
Begin with current-limited supplies and a battery emulator; no lithium cell connected during fault injection.
Use charge-enable-limits.json and measure actual supply envelope; pull-up domain qualification remains required before release.
Use appropriate high-impedance probes; record probe loading on CHG_GUARD_GATE.
measurements: independent stimulus resistance or calibrated surrogate temperature

cases.condition: Both comparator outputs released; MCU allow low
MCU allow high after valid USB power state

cases.stimulus: Slow sweep sensor resistance both directions
cases.required_behavior: Record cold/hot trip and recovery; no charge outside qualified window

cases.condition: VBUS present; repeat each sensor fault

cases.required_behavior: Cell/sensor temperature lag within allocated trip margin

acceptance_rules: No PASS without raw waveform and instrument metadata.
CE level margins must use charger datasheet limits and measured rail levels; logic state labels alone are insufficient.
Observe both stable levels and transient enable pulses during power sequencing.
Thermal thresholds must include sensor R-T tolerances, electrical trip error and measured sensor-to-cell lag; beta-only calculation cannot authorize actual charging.
If the candidate fails, redesign before actual-cell charge testing.
Five sample results do not establish full-lot/full-temperature production qualification.
Proposed bench margins: intended enabled CE <=0.30V; intended inhibited CE >=1.40V. Any indeterminate interval requires waveform review, not automatic PASS.

current_engineering_selection.scope: Engineering selection made; all physical results remain NOT_RUN
